en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan, from Muawiya Bin Ammar,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [22:36] then when they fall down, eat from them and feed the contented and the beggar. Heasws said: ‘The contented is the one who is contented with whatever you give him; and the الْمُعْتَرُّ is the one who passes by, and the beggar who asks you by his hand, and the الْبَائِسُ is the poor one’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn ‘Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said

the following: “This is about the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘When their sides reach the ground then eat thereof and feed to those contented and those who ask.’ [22:36] Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, has said al-Qani‘ is one who becomes satisfied with what you give them. Al-Mu‘tar are those who find you, al-Sa’il are those who beg you with their hands and al-Ba’is are the poor.’”
